source.title: Philippines Admin Level 4 (Barangay) Boundaries, PSA/NAMRIA, valid on 2023-11-06
source.publisher: Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) and National Mapping and Resource Information Authority (NAMRIA); distributed by UN OCHA on the Humanitarian Data Exchange (COD-AB PHL)
source.notes: Unsimplified polygons for Tarlac City's 76 barangays, coordinates rounded to 6 decimal places (about 0.1 m). Names with a parenthesised alternate (e.g. 'Buhilit (Bubulit)') are keyed by the app's canonical name; the official name is kept in official_name.
